items.raw_excerpt: Hidden away where the cliffs meet the sea, there's a place on the south coast of Cornwall that 'feels like stepping back in time.'
items.summary_en: A small village on the south coast of Cornwall has a look and feel that reminds people of Greece. It's being suggested as a nice spot for a short staycation.
items.summary_ko: 코른월 남부 해안의 작은 마을은 그리스와 비슷한 분위기를 자랑한다. 이곳은 짧은 휴가를 보내기 좋은 장소로 추천되고 있다.
items.title_original: Why the UK village dubbed ‘Little Greece’ should be your next staycation - Metro.co.uk

items.raw_excerpt: I have been in Bansko, Bulgaria for a few weeks now, and the thing that keepspulling my attention is not the mountains or the cost of living. It is the factt...
items.summary_en: A visitor has spent a few weeks in Bansko, Bulgaria. The mountains and the low cost of living are not what keeps pulling at their attention. They think places like Bir and Goa could learn from this small town.
items.summary_ko: 한 방문객이 불가리아 반스코에서 몇 주를 보냈다. 산도 생활비도 아닌 다른 점이 계속 눈길을 끌었다. 비르나 고아 같은 곳도 이 작은 마을에서 배울 점이 있다고 본다.
items.title_en: A Small Town in Bulgaria Draws Attention

items.raw_excerpt: From cooking to wine fairs and apple picking - this week’s La Belle Vie explores the little things that make the beginning of fall quite agreeable.
items.summary_en: This week's La Belle Vie looks at the small joys of early fall in France. It covers cooking, wine fairs, and apple picking. These simple things make autumn a lovely season.
items.summary_ko: 이번 주 라 벨 비는 프랑스 초가을의 작은 즐거움을 소개한다. 요리와 와인 축제, 사과 따기 같은 소박한 활동을 다룬다. 이런 소소한 것들이 가을을 더없이 좋은 계절로 만들어 준다.
items.title_en: La Belle Vie: Enjoying Autumn the French Way

items.raw_excerpt: Non-EU nationals with the right to live and work in Austria are generally issued a residence permit in the form of an ID card. But what do you if you happen to lose this vital document - or if it gets stolen? Here's a step-by-step guide.
items.summary_en: If you lose your Austrian residence permit, you need to report it right away to the local police. Then you must apply for a replacement at the immigration office.
items.summary_ko: 오스트리아에서 거주증을 분실한 경우, 즉시 경찰서에 신고해야 합니다. 이어서 이민청에 재발급을 신청해야 합니다.
items.title_en: How to replace a lost residence permit in Austria
items.title_ko: 오스트리아 거주증 분실 시 대처 방법
items.title_original: What you should do if you lose your residence permit in Austria

items.raw_excerpt: Sharp increase in dog population in many urban clusters has to do with failure on state to put in place an efficient waste management system.
items.summary_en: The number of dogs in many Indian cities is rising fast. Experts say the real problem is poor waste management and weak urban planning. They argue that killing dogs in large numbers is not a good answer.
items.summary_ko: 인도 여러 도시에서 개 개체 수가 빠르게 늘고 있다. 전문가들은 진짜 문제가 쓰레기 관리와 도시 계획의 미흡함에 있다고 말한다. 그래서 개를 대량으로 죽이는 것은 해답이 아니라고 주장한다.
items.title_en: Better Urban Planning, Not Mass Culling of Dogs

items.raw_excerpt: Vian, 16, has thalassemia and had to have monthly blood transfusions throughout her childhood.
items.summary_en: Vian is 16 and has thalassemia. As a child she needed monthly blood transfusions. Gene editing changed her life.

items.raw_excerpt: For many Americans, retirement marks the moment when life finally becomes spacious enough to imagine something different.
items.summary_en: Many Americans see retirement as a chance to imagine a different life. Some of them choose the Algarve in Portugal as their new home. The article shares their story of moving abroad.

items.summary_en: A survey highlights how neighborhoods in Curitiba voted for women running for federal, state, and local offices. It shows which areas gave the strongest support to female candidates.

items.raw_excerpt: The recent offer made by a film producer to Tamil superstar Rajinikanth to act in a movie on the ‘ >Tiger of Mysore ’, Tipu Sultan, has yet again opened up a Pandora’s Box.
items.summary_en: A film producer wants Tamil star Rajinikanth to play Tipu Sultan, the Tiger of Mysore. The offer has restarted an old argument about the ruler's legacy. Some call him a secular hero, others call him a bigot.
items.summary_ko: 한 영화 제작자가 타밀 스타 라지니칸트에게 마이소르의 호랑이 티푸 술탄 역할을 맡기자고 제안했다. 이 제안으로 티푸 술탄의 평가를 둘러싼 오래된 논쟁이 다시 불붙었다. 어떤 이는 그를 세속적 영웅이라 부르고, 어떤 이는 편협한 인물이라 부른다.
items.title_en: A film offer about Tipu Sultan stirs fresh debate in Karnataka
